flags.why: Cuồng sát means killing in a frenzy; in the example, muốn supplies the desire, so this does not establish a separate meaning of feeling an urge to kill.
This sense expresses contempt for someone's mean, petty character, as the [dictionary definition](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%E1%BA%A7n%20ti%E1%BB%87n) confirms.
The poverty sense is marked obsolete in the [dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%E1%BA%A7n%20ti%E1%BB%87n), so literary alone does not adequately label it.
Ngạnh cổ is not a natural Vietnamese expression for remaining stubborn or refusing to submit.
